Questing pace in the model, in kills per hour: 50 at 20, 69 at 30, 96 at 40, 104 at 50 and 127 at 60.

While leveling it also takes Blackout 4, Spirit Tap 2 and Dark Inspiration 1, which pay off for questing; respec those points into Shadow (PvP, model) at 60. A model leveling path, not yet tried in game.

Gear priority per point, relative to the best stat: at level 30, spell power 1, intellect 0.06 and crit rating 0.06; at level 60, spell power 1 and crit rating 0.25. The Recommended gear panel ranks items by these weights at your level.

caveats: Caster model (#163): Shadow Word: Pain and Devouring Plague kept up, Mind Blast and Shadow Word: Death on cooldown, Mind Flay or Smite in between, with Classic hit, crit and mana rules; a DoT or cooldown is dropped when its mana is worth more on the filler. Shadow Weaving counts at full stacks, and execute-range talents count for the share of the fight below their threshold. Vampiric Embrace's healing isn't modeled. Base stats are estimates; healer builds stay unscored.

Dungeon scores assume a 5-player group (#220): a tank, a healer, two more DPS and you, weighted by how often each class and spec shows up in Forever Logs. Group buffs come from the game client at your level; each provider uses the option that helps your build type (Might and Windfury for physical damage, Kings and the Elements for casters); a warrior tank keeps 5 Sunders up. Shadow Weaving, Improved Scorch and Winter's Chill only help their own caster in Forever, so they aren't group buffs. Raids and questing are unbuffed.
